collection.alt: Decision Lab’s Venue operations collection lists Review a street-team deployment version 1.1.0, its included operating app, a copied install link and Install collection.
collection.caption: The Marketplace collection supplies the guided review and its pinned operating app. The installation link opens this release directly.

starter.alt: The fresh review retains seven qualified staff, zero unavailable staff and a four-person inside minimum. The fictional staffing answer is awaiting review.
starter.caption: Start review preserves the supplied inputs and leaves them unreviewed. This fresh starting point has no calculated assessment, proposal or authorization.

financial.alt: The imported fictional article case shows the one-person push at $200, $40 contribution per additional guest, five guests to cover expense and six to exceed it. Operating requirements are met.
financial.caption: Alex’s separate reviewed case reproduces the four financial facts. Supporting assumptions open on request; the figures do not forecast customer response.

comparison.alt: The native financial comparison has four columns: deployment, additional expense, guests to cover and first count exceeding. Holding and all three promotion alternatives remain visible.
comparison.caption: The compact comparison keeps the financial differences together. Inspecting an alternative records no choice or authorization.

excelPreview.alt: Review workbook changes identifies one change to Unavailable qualified staff in the staffing worksheet, with Apply inputs available after review.
excelPreview.caption: The uploaded workbook previews the staffing change before it is applied. Applying inputs still leaves the changed answer awaiting review.

excelCoverage.alt: The installed workflow offers Download Excel and Upload Excel, identifies five supported worksheets and explains that other inputs remain in the saved case.
excelCoverage.caption: The workbook exposes selected inputs for this workflow. Access, spending delegation, the proposed choice and its specific authorization stay in the normal review controls.

thirdCallout.alt: The one-person push still costs $200 and needs five additional guests to cover it, but three callouts mean it no longer meets the operating requirements.
thirdCallout.caption: The financial hurdle is unchanged. Reduced staffing removes the operating basis for sending one promoter.
